clips.send: A mum sends it to her husband who finishes a bag of Doritos every night - anger at the ingredient printed right there on the bag.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's rule for chips: flip the bag over before you eat them.

On the US Doritos Nacho Cheese label, monosodium glutamate (MSG) is printed right there in the ingredient list. Kevin calls MSG an excitotoxin and says it makes you crave more of whatever you're eating.

His advice: if the label says monosodium glutamate, put it back. He says most fast food is loaded with it too.

What's the first thing you check on a label?

#kevintrudeau #msg #readthelabel #foodtruth #wbdaily #healthtruth
